content.title: About
content.content: Enfamil NFS is an infant formula for newborns and babies up to 6 months, formulated according to WHO recommendations. It provides an optimal balance of proteins, fats, carbohydrates, vitamins, and minerals needed for growth and development.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The formula is enriched with DHA and ARA – fatty acids important for brain and eye development.
It contains prebiotics to support a healthy gut microbiome.
Enfamil NFS is manufactured in the USA under strict quality and safety standards.
The composition meets the required levels of iron, zinc, and vitamin D for infants.

items.title: Supports growth
items.content: Balanced protein and energy content promotes normal weight gain and linear growth.

items.title: Brain development
items.content: DHA and ARA aid the development of the central nervous system and visual function.

items.title: Bone health
items.content: Vitamin D and calcium help build strong bone tissue.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Vitamins A, C and zinc strengthen the infant’s immune system.

items.title: Digestive health
items.content: Prebiotics foster beneficial gut bacteria, improving digestion.

items.title: Cow‑milk protein allergy
items.content: Some infants may develop an allergy to cow’s milk protein; discontinue use if symptoms appear.

items.title: Improper mixing
items.content: Over‑concentrated or overly diluted formula can lead to dehydration or over‑feeding.

items.title: Shelf life after opening
items.content: Once opened, the formula should be used within 48 hours to maintain quality.

content.title: How to Prepare
content.content: Mix the specified amount of powder with clean, boiled water, cool to room temperature, and feed the baby immediately. Do not heat the prepared bottle in a microwave.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the dry formula in a cool, dry place away from direct light. Keep the container tightly sealed after opening and use within 48 hours.
